title: circuitlib: a circuit verification library for Lean 4
abstract: A categorical semantics framework for digital circuits over Belnap's four-valued logic, following Ghica-Kaye-Sprunger. Its main theorems prove that combinational circuits (monotone functions on wire vectors) and sequential circuits (causal monotone stream functions) form symmetric monoidal categories, with a verified full adder as demonstration.

informal.Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.instSy: The category of sequential circuits, whose morphisms are causal monotone stream functions as in Ghica-Kaye-Sprunger's denotational semantics, is symmetric monoidal, with all coherence laws (pentagon, triangle, hexagons, symmetry) proven.
informal.Circuit.CombinationalCircuitCategory.ins: The category of combinational circuits, with wire counts as objects and monotone wire-vector functions as morphisms, is symmetric monoidal under juxtaposition of wire bundles.
informal.Circuit.SequentialCircuitCategory.tensor: Causality is preserved by parallel composition, the key lemma making sequential circuits closed under the tensor product.
informal.Circuit.BelnapLevel.instSemilatticeSup: Belnap's four truth values under the information order form a join-semilattice, the wire-value semantics in which every circuit denotes a monotone function.
informal.Circuit.CombinationalCircuit.adder_def: Correctness of a full adder assembled categorically from two half adders, gates, braidings, and whiskerings, computing the Boolean sum and carry bits; a demonstration of the framework.
